concepts.label: Log file (Couchbase Server)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the per-node, per-component log file family (audit, memcached, indexer, query, fts, goxdcr, etc.) this page catalogues; no promoted concept covers Server's own logging vocabulary.

concepts.label: static_config configuration file
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the per-node Erlang config file controlling log location, rotation settings, and component log levels ('loglevel_' entries); node-scoped, not cluster-propagated.

concepts.label: Log file rotation
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the size/count-bounded mechanism that deletes the oldest log file once a retention limit is reached; 8.0 changes this specifically for the Memcached log (aggregate-size-based rather than fixed-file-count).

concepts.label: Log redaction
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the mechanism that replaces sensitive log content (marked with <ud></ud> tags, or recognized by content in files that don't use the tags) with a SHA-1 hash during log collection.

concepts.label: mcctl
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the per-node CLI tool for getting/setting the Memcached slow-operation logging threshold (MCBP SLA configuration); not in the promoted tool: family.

concepts.label: cblogredaction
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the standalone CLI tool for redacting plain-text log files created outside the Couchbase cluster (by cbbackupmgr, SDKs, connectors, Mobile); not in the promoted tool: family.

concepts.label: cbcollect_info
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - the log-collection utility this page's 'Collect Logs' section documents both via CLI and via the Web Console's Collect Information tab.

concepts.label: Full Admin / Full Administrator (Server RBAC role)
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - one of the two roles that can collect logs via Web Console.

concepts.label: Cluster Admin (Server RBAC role)
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - one of the two roles that can collect logs via Web Console.

concepts.label: Auditing (Server security facility)
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - this page explicitly distinguishes the audit log's own settings from general logging ('Couchbase Server auditing has its own log settings.').

relations.subject: log:log-rotation
relations.evidence: You can change log rotation settings by editing the `static_config` configuration file.

relations.subject: log:log-file
relations.evidence: It's possible to change the location where Couchbase Server saves log files. However, Couchbase only supports the default log location. Changing the log location requires manually editing a configuration file named `static_config`.

relations.subject: log:log-rotation
relations.evidence: In Couchbase Server 8.0 and later, Memcached log retention is based on total disk usage (aggregated size) rather than a fixed number of rotated files.

relations.subject: tool:cblogredaction
relations.evidence: Some Couchbase features, such as `cbbackupmgr`, the SDK, connectors, and Mobile, create log files saved outside the Couchbase cluster. You can redact these files using the `cblogredaction` command-line tool.

relations.subject: tool:cbcollect-info
relations.evidence: Couchbase Server saves the collected log files as zip files in a temporary location on each node.

relations.subject: log:log-file
relations.evidence: To retrieve log information, use the `/diag` and `/sasl_logs` [REST endpoints](../../rest-api/logs-rest-api.md).

notable_absence.finding: The page states threshold changes made with mcctl are 'non-persistent. When the node restarts, thresholds reset to their default values' but never states what RBAC role, if any, is required to run mcctl - unlike log collection, which explicitly names Full Admin/Cluster Admin. This leaves mcctl's own authorization model completely undocumented on this page.

cross_component_finding: Nine REST-configurable logging levels/settings are listed in a table (FTS enableVerboseLogging/setSlowQueryLogTimeout, Index Service indexer.settings.log_level/statsLogDumpInterval/projector.settings.log_level, Query Service loglevel) alongside the static_config-file path for components with NO REST setting - the same two-tier configuration-surface split (REST/UI vs config-file-only) already seen for the Backup Service (REST+UI vs no-CLI-equivalent) and for Index Service settings (REST vs CLI) elsewhere in this batch. mcctl is a THIRD configuration surface (neither REST nor static_config) for a single specific setting (Memcached slow-operation threshold), reinforcing that Couchbase Server's administrative surface is fragmented across REST, Web Console, static_config, and small dedicated CLI tools with no single authoritative configuration path.
